howItWorks.h2: From Invoice to Control in 4 Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Organize your billing in a clear and efficient way. A straightforward workflow to keep full control of your invoicing.

step1.title: Add Your Clients
step1.desc: Manually add your clients. Store contact details and payment terms in one centralized place.

step2.title: Create the Invoice
step2.desc: Generate invoices quickly with items, amounts, and due dates. Set up recurring invoices whenever needed.

step3.title: Send and Track
step3.desc: Send invoices via email and monitor their due status. The system automatically sends reminders 3 days before, on the due date, and up to 7 days after if unpaid.

step4.title: Update the Status
step4.desc: After receiving payment through your preferred method (Pix, bank transfer, card, etc.), mark the invoice as paid and keep your financial records up to date.

faq.subtitle: Clear answers about how Emitfy works.
faq.a1: Emitfy is an invoice management platform designed to help you organize, send, and track your invoices in one place. It allows you to monitor due dates, manage clients, and keep control of your billing workflow.
faq.a2: No. Emitfy does not process payments. It helps you manage invoices and track their status. Payments can be received through Pix, bank transfer, card, or any other method you use externally.
faq.q3: How do recurring invoices and reminders work?
faq.a3: You can configure recurring invoices based on your preferred frequency. The system automatically sends reminders 3 days before the due date, on the due date, and up to 7 days after if the invoice remains unpaid.
faq.q4: How do I mark an invoice as paid?
faq.a4: Once you receive payment outside the platform, you can manually mark the invoice as paid. This keeps your records updated and ensures accurate tracking.
faq.a5: Yes. We follow modern security practices, including protected authentication and secure data storage, to safeguard your information.
